skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the structure of buildings and construction projects, read and interpret construction drawings, and apply knowledge to estimate quantities and costs.
Understand and apply construction standards and regulations, and interpret construction drawings.
Develop skills in breaking down project tasks, using cost and quantity standards, and preparing tender documents.
Learn to prepare construction budgets and manage project costs.
Work effectively in teams, showing responsibility and cooperation.
Develop independent learning skills and the ability to find and use resources.
Write reports and presentations for project groups and problem-solving.
